details:
The  package provides a command line tool which can be used to * create a working container from scratch or * create a working container from an image as a starting point * mount/umount a working container&apos;s root file system for manipulation * save container&apos;s root file system layer to create a new image * delete a working container or an image

Security Fix(es):

When processing HTTP/2 SETTINGS frames, transport will enter an infinite loop of writing CONTINUATION frames if it receives a SETTINGS_MAX_FRAME_SIZE with a value of 0.(CVE-2026-33814)
